badge.description: A structural enum on a member kept whole: allowed, since it is not a cut node (spec 6.10).

note.description: Free-form note; never a whole Profile. Not a cut node, so projection leaves its schema, and the shared Profile it names, unchanged (spec 6.10).

display-name.description: The name shown in the directory; its key is not an identifier, so its field path is ["display-name"].

attributes.description: Free-form directory attributes: a map, so each key is selectable (spec 6.10).

labels.description: Label sets, one map per source: an array of maps, so keys are selected through labels[] (spec 6.10).

settings.description: A map written with an empty properties member, as some schema generators emit it.
